```artifact
## Use-Cases & User Stories

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to link to specific sections of text within requirements documents.
**So that** I can easily navigate between different sections of the document.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to format the text within linkable sections.
**So that** I can highlight important information and make the document more visually appealing.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to store external requirements assets.
**So that** I can reference external documents and resources within my requirements document.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to import content from other requirements management tools.
**So that** I can consolidate my requirements into a single document.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to export content to interact with common text/document tools.
**So that** I can share my requirements document with other stakeholders.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to view requirements as a document.
**So that** I can easily review and understand the requirements.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to view document items interactively.
**So that** I can navigate between different sections of the document and interact with the content.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to baseline versions of requirements.
**So that** I can track changes to the requirements over time.
```
